requirements.text: In case of doubt, when verifying paragraphs 5.10.1. and 5.10.2., the requirement shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.quote: In case of doubt, the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.

requirements.text: In case of doubt, when verifying paragraphs 5.10.1. and 5.10.2., the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.quote: In case of doubt, the requirement above shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the rear position lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously with the front position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.quote: Reversing lamp: White

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Stop lamp: Red

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.quote: Rear position lamp: Red

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
requirements.quote: Rear retro-reflector, non- triangular: Red

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.

requirements.text: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp and the rear retro-reflector may be installed on movable components only if at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
requirements.quote: If at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.

requirements.text: Where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an interdependent lamp system and the complete interdependent lamp system is mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied.
requirements.quote: (a) Should the complete interdependent lamp system be mounted on the moving component(s), the requirements of paragraph 5.18.1. shall be satisfied.

requirements.text: Where the complete interdependent lamp system is mounted on the moving component(s), additional lamps for the above functions may be switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.quote: However, additional lamps for the above functions may be switched ON, when the movable component is in any fixed open position, provided that these additional lamps satisfy all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component; or

requirements.text: Where the interdependent lamp system is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly on a movable component, with the exception of direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.quote: (b) Should the interdependent lamp system be partly mounted on the fixed component and partly mounted on a movable component, with the exception of direction indicator lamps, the interdependent lamp(s) specified by the Applicant during the device approval procedure shall meet all the position, outwards geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).

requirements.text: Where the interdependent lamp system is partly mounted on the fixed component and partly on a movable component, the inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) is(are) deemed to be satisfied if the interdependent lamp(s) still conform(s) to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).
requirements.quote: The inwards geometric visibility requirement(s) is(are) deemed to be satisfied if this(these) interdependent lamp(s) still conform(s) to the photometric values prescribed in the field of light distribution for the approval of the device, at all fixed positions of the movable component(s).

requirements.text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.quote: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.quote: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.quote: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".

requirements.text: If the requirement that the apparent surface shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component; or

requirements.text: If the requirement that the apparent surface shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent is not practicable, a remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components.
requirements.quote: A remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components; and

requirements.text: If the requirement that the apparent surface shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent is not practicable, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road.
requirements.quote: A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.

requirements.text: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark shall be deemed not to be present when the lamp cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.
requirements.quote: With the exception of retro-reflectors, a lamp even bearing an approval mark is deemed not to be present when it cannot be made to operate by the sole installation of a light source and/or a fuse.

requirements.text: The rear lamp approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance.
requirements.quote: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: The rear lamp approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: Where a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement function in case of a failure shall be similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate.
requirements.quote: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.

requirements.text: Where a temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp is provided, the replacement device shall remain operational in its original safety function.
requirements.quote: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.

requirements.text: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.quote: During replacement, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.

requirements.text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of the rear position lamp may be allowed only if the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.
requirements.quote: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp is allowed, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, the voltage supplied at the terminals of the rear lamp which, according to its type approval documentation, has been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
requirements.quote: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, in all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the rear lamp function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.quote: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.

requirements.text: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to the rear lamp where it includes an electronic light source control gear.
requirements.quote: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices which include: - an electronic light source control gear, or - a variable intensity control being part of the device, or - only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.

requirements.text: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to the rear lamp where it includes a variable intensity control being part of the device.
requirements.quote: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices which include: - an electronic light source control gear, or - a variable intensity control being part of the device, or - only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.

requirements.text: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to the rear lamp where it includes only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.quote: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices which include: - an electronic light source control gear, or - a variable intensity control being part of the device, or - only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.

requirements.text: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to the rear lamp where it includes an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.quote: The provisions of paragraphs 5.27.1. and 5.27.2. shall not apply to devices which include: - an electronic light source control gear, or - a variable intensity control being part of the device, or - only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the rear lamp observed from infinity, except that no account is taken of obstacles if they were already presented when the rear lamp was type-approved.
requirements.quote: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity. However, no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.

requirements.text: If measurements are taken closer to the rear lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
requirements.quote: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.

requirements.text: If, when the rear lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the rear lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the rear lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.quote: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.

requirements.text: Where applicable, all lamps (devices) shall be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.quote: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.

requirements.text: When installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, the rear lamp shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only, except that this requirement does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except for when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
requirements.quote: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be present on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4.
requirements.quote: Mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4.

requirements.text: On motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm, one reversing lamp device shall be installed.
requirements.quote: One device mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: These devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground, except that for category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.
requirements.quote: In height: not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground. For category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle, except that if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. below are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: In length: at the rear of the vehicle However, if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. below are fulfilled.

requirements.text: For reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be α = 15° upwards.
requirements.quote: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.

requirements.text: For reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be α = 5° downwards.
requirements.quote: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.

requirements.text: If there is only one reversing lamp device installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be β = 45° to right and to left.
requirements.quote: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.

requirements.text: If there are two reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be β = 45° outwards and 30° inwards.
requirements.quote: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.

requirements.text: For the reversing lamp installed at the rear of the vehicle, the geometric visibility, defined by angles α and β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards.
requirements.quote: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.

requirements.text: For the reversing lamp installed at the rear of the vehicle, if there is only one device, the geometric visibility, defined by angles α and β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be β = 45° to right and to left.
requirements.quote: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.

requirements.text: For the reversing lamp installed at the rear of the vehicle, if there are two devices, the geometric visibility, defined by angles α and β as specified in paragraph 2.10.7., shall be β = 45° outwards and 30° inwards.
requirements.quote: Devices installed at the rear of the vehicle: Defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.

requirements.text: For the two optional reversing lamps mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. if fitted on the side of the vehicle, the geometric visibility shall be considered to be ensured if the reference axis of the respective reversing lamp is directed outwards with an angle β not exceeding 15° relative to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The geometric visibility is considered to be ensured if the reference axis of the respective device is directed outwards with an angle β not exceeding 15° relative to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.quote: Rearwards

requirements.text: If the two optional reversing lamps mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. are fitted on the side of the vehicle, the provisions of paragraph 6.4.5.2. shall apply to the reversing lamps.
requirements.quote: In addition, if the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2., are fitted on the side of the vehicle, the provisions of paragraph 6.4.5.2. above shall apply.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.quote: They shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.

requirements.text: If either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible, the reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON.
requirements.quote: It shall not switch ON or remain ON if either of the above conditions is not satisfied.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be present on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.quote: Devices of S1 or S2 categories: mandatory on all categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices of S3 or S4 category shall be present on M1 and N1 categories of vehicles, except for chassis-cabs and those N1 category vehicles with open cargo space.
requirements.quote: Devices of S3 or S4 category: mandatory on M1 and N1 categories of vehicles, except for chassis-cabs and those N1 category vehicles with open cargo space; optional on other categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: The vehicle shall have two S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.quote: Number Two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: The vehicle shall have one S3 or S4 category stop lamp device on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.quote: Number Two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: The devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall be provided as two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.quote: Two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 category stop lamps, the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: For S1 or S2 categories devices that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle;

requirements.text: For all other categories of vehicles, for S1 or S2 category stop lamps, the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm if the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm. This distance may be reduced to 400 mm if the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: For S3 or S4 category stop lamps on all other categories of vehicles, the centre of reference shall be situated on the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, except that where two S3 or S4 category stop lamps are installed according to paragraph 6.7.2.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 category devices: the centre of reference shall be situated on the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: Where two S3 or S4 category stop lamps are installed, according to paragraph 6.7.2., the stop lamps shall be positioned as close as possible to the median longitudinal plane, one on each side of this plane.
requirements.quote: However, in the case where the two devices of the S3 or S4 category are installed, according to paragraph 6.7.2., they shall be positioned as close as possible to the median longitudinal plane, one on each side of this plane.

requirements.text: In the case where one S3 or S4 category stop lamp offset from the median longitudinal plane is permitted according to paragraph 6.7.2., the offset shall not exceed 150 mm from the median longitudinal plane to the centre of reference of the lamp.
requirements.quote: In the case where one S3 or S4 category lamp offset from the median longitudinal plane is permitted according to paragraph 6.7.2., this offset shall not exceed 150 mm from the median longitudinal plane to the centre of reference of the lamp.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories devices, the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle;

requirements.text: For all other categories of vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories devices, the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm, except that this distance may be reduced to 400 mm if the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.
requirements.quote: For S1 or S2 categories devices the distance in between the inner edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall be not less than 600 mm. This distance may be reduced to 400 mm if the overall width of the vehicle is less than 1,300 mm.

requirements.text: For S3 or S4 category devices, the centre of reference of the stop lamp shall be situated on the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, except that where the two devices of the S3 or S4 category are installed according to paragraph 6.7.2., the devices shall be positioned as close as possible to the median longitudinal plane, one on each side of this plane.
requirements.quote: For S3 or S4 category devices: the centre of reference shall be situated on the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle. However, in the case where the two devices of the S3 or S4 category are installed, according to paragraph 6.7.2., they shall be positioned as close as possible to the median longitudinal plane, one on each side of this plane.

requirements.text: In the case where one S3 or S4 category lamp offset from the median longitudinal plane is permitted according to paragraph 6.7.2., the offset shall not exceed 150 mm from the median longitudinal plane to the centre of reference of the lamp.
requirements.quote: In the case where one S3 or S4 category lamp offset from the median longitudinal plane is permitted according to paragraph 6.7.2., this offset shall not exceed 150 mm from the median longitudinal plane to the centre of reference of the lamp.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 category stop lamps shall be not less than 350 mm and not more than 1,500 mm above the ground, except that the maximum height may be 2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed.
